content.short: Pendle tokenizes future yield from DeFi assets, allowing users to fix yields, speculate on rates, or trade yield separately from principal on Mantle.
content.description: Pendle Finance is a yield trading protocol that splits yield-bearing assets into Principal Tokens (PT) and Yield Tokens (YT), enabling users to trade future yield separately from principal  analogous to interest rate swaps in traditional finance. Users can lock in fixed yields, speculate on yield rates rising or falling, or provide liquidity to Pendle's specialized AMM to earn fees from yield traders. Deployed on Mantle, Pendle brings sophisticated yield trading to the network's LST and LRT markets.
content.meta: Pendle tokenizes and enables trading of future DeFi yield for fixed returns or yield speculation on Mantle. Discover Pendle on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
